name: esp-input-bridge
description: Use ESP32 hardware mouse and keyboard input from an existing agent, with no second model call.

interface.longDescription: Replace software mouse and keyboard injection with ESP32-C3 BLE HID or ESP32-S3 BLE/USB HID. Your existing agent keeps its reasoning role. Three local MCP tools observe, execute a bounded batch, and stop. Demo mode works without a device. Real operation requires a provisioned board, local configuration, and screen capture permission. Physical-board validation is pending; hardware input does not guarantee avoiding automation detection.
defaultPrompt: Run the hardware input demo without connecting a board.
Help configure my ESP32 hardware input adapter.
